subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should `message.send` ignore schema-populated poll creation fields at runtime, or should the message tool schema be action/channel-scoped so ordinary sends never expose poll creation fields?
rationale: Current main intentionally rejects content-bearing poll fields on `send`, while the issue asks that ordinary sends not be blocked by fields exposed through the shared schema; the choice changes a cross-channel tool contract.

options.title: Action-scope the schema
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only on the poll-capable action/schema path, keeping ordinary sends small while preserving strict misuse errors for real poll payloads.

options.title: Sanitize send params
options.body: Strip poll creation params from `action="send"` before the guard, matching the linked PR direction but silently ignoring poll-looking content on send.

options.title: Keep current guard
options.body: Treat `pollQuestion` and `pollOption` on `send` as true poll intent and close only if maintainers decide the modifier-only fix is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Action-scope the schema
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only on the poll-capable action/schema path, keeping ordinary sends small while preserving strict misuse errors for real poll payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and merged PR history put the shared message-tool schema and guard decision closest to this owner path.
